dossier.public_summary: The four dips are not consistent with each other and the one dip looks much deeper in the TESS-SPOC sector than in the QLP sector, with odd and even dips alternating in depth. On this small, very spotted M-dwarf that is consistent with a false variable or blended binary, and centroid imaging cannot place the signal firmly on the target. The best explanation is not a repeating planet transit.

reasons.why: Individual transits are not consistent; chi2 63.54620713589689 dof 3 with one negative/outlier transit at -218 ppm sigma -6.5 shows signal is not repeatable, with 4 transits and share_of_top_3 1.0 driven by few events.

Depth changes sharply between products: 15800 +/-1300 ppm in TESS-SPOC sector 54 vs 8609 +/-1381 ppm in QLP sector 81, depth_change_pct 58.92. sector_depths_by_source verdict changes_within_a_source with per_sector differences, not a calibration offset.

Odd vs even depth ratio 1.8 indicates alternating depths at 8.8d, depth_difference_ppm 6451 depth_difference 0.4298, with sector_oe_max_sigma 6.454 and sector_oe_sectors_over_3 1, classic eclipsing-binary / blend sign.

M-dwarf is highly spotted with variability chi2 similar to transit depth but shape flat and individual transits inconsistent, so residual systematics cannot rescue planet case; together with odd/even and sector instability this favours variability/blend over planet.
reasons.value: rotation sector 54 period_d 0.549 amplitude_ppm 13362, sector 81 period_d 0.42 amplitude_ppm 14942; shape v_sigma -4.306 flat but duration ratio 1.606 (observed_h 3 vs central_h 1.868) and star_density_penalty 30.81 favour non-planet density.

reasons.why: No on_target confirmation and low planet score complete the evidence against a planet on the target despite planet-sized estimate rp_over_rstar 0.1148.
reasons.value: centroid verdict inconclusive no sector with clear difference image; neighbours plausible_within_1px 1 could_cause 59 xgboost planet_rank 0.08; size rp_rearth 4.293 plausible but not constraining
